messages.subject: Pre / Post / Follow-Up Factor Scores
parts:
Hi phil and all the other experts,

I have a pre-post-followup test design with around 300 pupils. the 3 tests have completely identical (ordinal) items. I would like to calculate separate factor scores for each test so I can use the results in further regression analysis.
I'm not very knowledged about the IRT, sorry for my possibly dumb question: Do I calculate separate item parameters for each time point pre / post / follow-up and derive the factor scores from those or is it more appropriate to calculate ONE item parameter model and use the same item parameters to calculate the three factor score sets?
I hope my question is understandable... I've also read your articles about longitudinal IRT / growth IRT but I'm not sure if it is applicable since I want to use the factor scores for further regression analysis.

Thanks for your expertise in advance, have a wonderful day!

Martin
